page.layout: One page of text. At the top, a centred dedication title block in larger type, then a salutation line. Below, the body of the dedication opens with a large woodcut initial. Page number at top right. Signature at bottom right.

l.i: se in stationem beatam evocavit. Quem luctum eo acerbiorem T.C. scio accidisse,
quòd eo semper optimo parente & duce fide-

page.notes: The large woodcut initial "A" is joined to the word "CERBISSIMVM", giving "ACERBISSIMVM". The line "D E O" is set in spaced capitals and is transcribed as "DEO". The body text is set in italic throughout. No running head, catchword or margin notes are printed. The line-end hyphen in "fide-" is printed. The "3" at top right is the printed page number. Show-through and scan edge marks have been left out.
